verdict.rationale: Fireworks offers a 'guided path' fine-tuning flow where you 'describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run' (fireworks-ai-docs-31), which is a natural-language front-end for one workflow, but there's no broader evidence of NL-driven control over deployments, scaling, or general platform operations. missing for 10: NL command support across core operations (deployment management, scaling, monitoring), independent/hands-on confirmation of the guided-path feature working as described.
